scoring.aggregation: Three buckets, each scored as the unweighted mean of its own checks, then blended on the fixed 1:2:3 weighting. Every check inside a bucket carries weight 1 and is counted once.
scoring.formula: reward = (total_static_check_score * 1 + total_reward_hacking_check_score * 2 + total_partial_oracle_check_score * 3) / 6, where each bucket score is passed / total within that bucket
scoring.note: The blend is not an equal-weighted mean over all checks and is declared here for that reason: each bucket contributes a fixed share of the reward however many checks it holds. There is no multiplier, gate, cap, floor or constant applied to the blended reward, and a fully correct submission reaches a true 1.0. Structural share is one sixth, 16.7 percent, and content, meaning the reward-hacking and partial-oracle buckets together, is five sixths, 83.3 percent. The static and reward-hacking buckets are denominated per appeal over the whole corpus rather than as corpus-wide booleans, so no single check in either carries more than one percent of the reward. Every partial-oracle check evaluates the authorship precondition inside the check rather than as a gate on the total, so the reward stays additive. verify.py also emits content_score and structural_score alongside the four required reward.json fields and a per-check breakdown carrying name, bucket, score and notes.

oracle.source: tests/test_logic/vendor/answer_key.json, hand authored by reading both decisions of every appeal and validated so that each quote is verbatim in the document it names and each penalty component's rate times days equals its total.
oracle.held_out: The key and the grader's copies of the decisions live under tests/ and never enter the agent environment.
oracle.qd_03_1_disclosure: This is an INTENTIONAL, DISCLOSED comparison against a held-out key, declared here so it is assessed on its design rather than read as an undisclosed oracle diff. The deliverable is a closed-vocabulary extraction: every scored field is an enum fixed by instruction.md, an identifier copied off a caption, an arithmetic quantity, or a verbatim quote, so there is no free-text surface a rubric could judge and no second correct answer a judge would accept. Facts are DERIVED FROM THE SOURCE DOCUMENTS at grading time rather than trusted from the key: every unit's credit requires its two quotes to be found verbatim in the grader's own copies of that appeal's two decisions, outside the caption block, and its Board quote to sit within six thousand characters of the key passage AND share at least a fifth of its content words. A record that guesses the right enum values without the supporting passages earns nothing, which is what separates this from a field-by-field answer diff.
oracle.qd_03_1_partial_credit: The key is a denominator, not a gate. Scoring is granular at the level of the individual contested issue: 1255 partial-oracle checks over 283 units and 45 appeals, each independently scored, so a submission that gets one issue right on one appeal earns that check and nothing about a failure elsewhere removes it. The denominator is the key's unit set over the whole corpus rather than what the submission chose to write, so omission cannot raise the score.

reward_hacking_checks_1.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: This is the check that proves both documents were read for this appeal. Quotes are matched against grader-held copies, so text the agent wrote into its own workspace cannot ground them, and excluding the caption region defeats the boilerplate header that is verbatim in every ALJ decision. The evidence-relevance window is what makes this a comprehension test rather than a retrieval one: mere presence somewhere in the correct document is not authorship, because an agent holding the same files can slice arbitrary passages out of them without understanding any of them. Requiring the ALJ-side quote to sit near the passage the key records for the same issue means the quote has to have been chosen for that issue. The non-overlapping span rule stops one passage from being re-counted as several pieces of evidence by shifting its start or end a character at a time. The padding cap defeats the cheapest script-only attack on this check, which is to emit the cross-product of every issue category with every regulatory citation regexed out of the decision, each carrying an arbitrary long sentence lifted from the correct document, and let alignment find the combinations that happen to collide with real issues.
